# Tomás Ferreira

> Forward-deployed AI builder based in Portugal.

Tomás Ferreira builds AI agents, workflow automations, browser tools, internal tools, API-powered products, and startup MVPs.

He works across engineering, product, strategy, sales, growth, and customer discovery.

He is strongest in zero-to-one environments where the business problem is messy and the product needs to be built, tested, sold, and improved quickly.

## Positioning

Tomás is a commercially minded AI + automation builder.

He combines:

- sales experience
- GTM thinking
- startup execution
- customer discovery
- MVP validation
- founder-style ownership
